title: Ride the runway to ₹1 crore
intro: Compounding is an exponent with two enemies: a short runway and a slow leak.
briefing: You're compounding at a 1.5% annual drag — fees, churn, taxes quietly eating the exponent. Reach a ₹1 crore corpus while keeping the total lost to drag under 8% of the gross. Time runs at a year per second; the drag knob is the lever most investors never touch.
debrief: The outcome lives in the exponent — rate × years — and drag attacks the rate itself, so its cost COMPOUNDS with the runway: the longer you ride, the more an innocuous 1.5% steals. Cutting drag to ~0.5% clears the goal on the same SIP and the same market. That's the wealth-creator's discipline applied to your own portfolio: protect the exponent (stay invested, keep costs and churn near zero) and let the runway do the work our intuition can't.
